article_notes: 40 dogs with signs of hepatitis in Kerala; 9 had babesiosis (B. gibsoni, smear diagnosis). Haematology (5 variables, Table 2) and biochemistry (8 variables, Table 3) of the babesiosis dogs are compared with laboratory reference values by one-sample t-test. This is infected vs reference (healthy) and not a severity comparison; nothing was extracted. No outcome or severity grouping of the babesiosis dogs is reported.
